title: BEClient — in-process research component
summary: vmcall's February 2019 BattlEye investigation describes BEClient as a Windows DLL mapped into the game process after initialization. The account separates client-context detections from the kernel driver and backend, and explicitly warns that its sampled shellcode may become obsolete.
affectedVersions: Architecture and sampled shellcode described in February 2019 research; current releases and exact DLL filenames are not established by this record.
